bio: In the centre of Zurich, right next to the Münsterhof square, this compact restaurant is tucked away in a side street. The concept is counter dining, with guests seated at the counter for a set menu that takes its cue from the seasons. The cuisine is Asian, with an emphasis on seafood. A choice of sake, wine or alcohol-free beverages complements the food. The set menu is served at two sittings from Thu to Mon. Be sure to reserve, as the restaurant has only eight seats! Given the location not far from the River Limmat, it would be a shame to miss the opportunity to take a stroll while you are here....
